subject: Re: Kickoff: grasping benchmark revival (dql_grasping)
body:
Decisions before next week's sweep, since we're out of slack:

1. Throughput landed at 85% of budget — good recovery Nikhil — but not 100%, so per Efe's recommendation we cut the hardest difficulty tier from the grid and keep all 5 seeds. The tier comes back as a follow-up run in July on best-effort.
2. PCL stays in the sweep: Quentin's fix (decoupling the replay-buffer sampling from the ported eligibility-trace code) held for two weeks of soak. If it diverges mid-sweep we drop it and say so in the readout, we don't rerun.
3. Readout moves from July 2 to July 6 to give Wanjiru time to build the comparison dashboards off the sweep output directly.

Our reservation week is what everything hangs on now — Alina, please reconfirm the booking with Infra today and make sure our job configs are staged by Friday.

Ulla
